summary: Torres-Walker called for a Gaza ceasefire on October 24, 2023, days after the conflict began, invoking “Free Palestine” and condemning colonialism. In March 2024 she repeatedly proposed and demanded the Antioch council pass a ceasefire resolution, saying she would keep asking until it reached a regular agenda. CAIR Action endorsed her in the general and Vote for Peace rated her an Ally.
